title: [main] bug 658615 - Fix print of VAT Statement with Opposite Sign option
summary: The Czech VAT Statement report now prints amounts with the correct sign when configured with the Opposite Sign option, while preserving the intended zeroing behavior from visibility rules.
key_points: Fixes incorrect amount signs in Czech VAT Statement when Print with option is set to Opposite Sign
Report restores the configured print sign after applying Zero If Negative and Zero If Positive rules
Simplifies Boolean expressions in ShowAmountAsZero() method without changing behavior
Limited to Czech localization; no schema or public API changes
Low-risk fix affecting only amount sign handling in reporting
quote: The report now restores the print sign after applying the Zero If Negative / Zero If Positive rules.
